description: EXPLAIN returns the structural execution plan - operator steps and scanned tables - as a result set: a step number, the operator name, and the object it reads where there is one. A full SELECT lays out Result / Limit / Sort / Aggregate / Filter / TableScan in that order, a join adds a Join step above one TableScan per side, and EXPLAIN USING TABULAR produces the same shape for a bare scan. Converted 1:1 from query/ExplainTest (now retired); the Java collected the operator column into a SET and asserted membership, which discarded both the step ORDER and the scanned-object column, and the converted tests state the whole ordered plan instead. Every test keeps the class's assumeFalse as skip snowflake: an EXPLAIN plan on a real account is Snowflake's own internal plan shape, with different rows, columns and operator names.
